{{Top|leg}}
The '''Battle of Kryndyn''' was an engagement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zelos II]] in the year [[4 BBY/Legends|4 BBY]]. A horde of nocturnal predators attacked the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kryndyn]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] the planetary leadership. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Galleros Nul]] of the [[Zelosian Home Defense Force]] rallied his forces and counterattacked, driving the beasts out of the city. The action led him to declare martial law on the planet, and install himself as the [[Mandated Commander of the People of Zelos]].
